limits.en: 60 MB storage, unlimited tasks, up to 2 teams/spaces, 1 form, basic views, 100 automation executions/month.

keyLimits.en: Unlimited storage, all integrations, native time tracking, up to 3 teams/spaces.
Unlimited dashboards, 5,000 automation executions/month, mind mapping, up to 10 teams/spaces.
250,000 automation executions/month, custom roles, SAML SSO, dedicated support.

addOns.en: Brain AI add-on: $9/mo (~$7.20 annualized) for unlimited assistant and 1,500 AI Super Credits; Everything AI at $28/mo for the full agentic suite and 5,000 AI Super Credits.

cautions.en: Automation execution caps (100 free / 5,000 Business / 250,000 Enterprise) can force an upgrade for heavy automation users even if seat count stays low.

capabilities.en: All-in-one work management: tasks, docs, dashboards, chat, whiteboards and goal tracking in one workspace.
Built-in native time tracking and automations, configurable per space/folder/list.
Optional "Brain" AI layer (assistant, agents, image generation) sold as a per-seat add-on on top of the core plan.

limitations.en: Free plan storage is capped at only 60 MB, far below most competitors' free tiers.
Full AI feature set is a separate paid add-on rather than bundled into the paid plans.

reason.en: Widely used project management competitor with similar task/workflow focus.
Direct competitor in the all-in-one work OS category.
Simpler board-based alternative often compared to ClickUp for smaller teams.

unknowns: Exact list of native integrations and mobile platform availability (iOS/Android) was not re-verified on an official page in this session.
